title: Resolution urging Congress to pass the AI Sovereign Wealth Fund Act
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass and the President to sign S.4825, the American A.I. Sovereign Wealth Fund Act, sponsored by Senator Bernie Sanders. The bill would impose a one-time 50 percent tax on the equity of the largest AI companies to create a public sovereign wealth fund invested on behalf of the public. The Council argues the public should share in financial benefits generated from AI's use of public data.
